update reservation
status = #{reservationVO.status},
money = #{reservationVO.money},
order_time = #{reservationVO.orderTime},
problem = #{reservationVO.problem},
answer = #{reservationVO.answer},
rate = #{reservationVO.rate},
rate_score = #{reservationVO.rateScore},
rate_time = #{reservationVO.rateTime}
where reservation_id = #{reservationVO.reservationId}

update scheduling
begin_time = #{schedulingVO.beginTime},
end_time = #{schedulingVO.endTime},
status = #{schedulingVO.status},
where scheduling_id = #{schedulingVO.schedulingId}
mapper.select: select r.*,u.name as userName,c.role,ha.name as consultantName,d.name as domainName from reservation r left join domain d on r.domain_id = d.domain_id left join user u on r.user_id = u.user_id left join consultant c on r.consultant_id = c.consultant_id left join hou_admin ha on c.admin_id = ha.admin_id where reservation_id = #{reservationId}
select order_time from reservation where consultant_id = #{consultantId} and status = 1 or consultant_id = #{consultantId} and status = 2
select avg(cast(rate_score as decimal)) from reservation where consultant_id = #{consultantId} and rate_score is not null
select * from scheduling where consultant_id = #{consultantId} and status = 0
